Creamy Tomato Chicken Skillet

  • Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook until browned, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
  • Add half the butter and the onion to the skillet and cook until soft, about 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
  • Pour in the broth, tomatoes and cream. Simmer 5 minutes, then return the chicken to the pan.
  • Stir in the remaining butter, the parmesan and the spinach until wilted. Taste and add more salt if needed.
